dedupe_keys.name: rdg approved code of practice rail emergency management anticipation assessment and prevention acop 009

description: This Approved Code of Practice from the Rail Delivery Group covers the anticipation, assessment and prevention stages of integrated emergency management in the British rail industry. Issue 2.0 (10 March 2025, 68 pages) follows the Rail Resilience Project Emergency Management Review completed in June 2021 and was revised against ACOP 008 to 012. The executive summary cites major derailments, structural change in the industry, technology upgrades, climate impacts on ageing infrastructure, industrial action, cyber attacks and fires as reasons to manage the risk of major emergencies. It was prepared by Fynbos Consulting for the Rail Resilience Steering Group, whose members include train operators, Network Rail, DfT, TfL, Transport Scotland, BTP, ORR and RSSB. Coverage: the GB railway. Format and access: free PDF. Licence and cost: free; no reuse licence is stated. Caveats: advisory, not mandatory, and reviewed on a three-year cycle. It supports emergency response and resilience studies of rail operations. It relates to the Network Rail WRCCA plans and the RAIB reports in the catalogue.
